summary: Learn how AI can enhance sustainability in Central Bank libraries. Join our training course to explore innovative solutions and best practices.
lede: AI and sustainability in central bank libraries focus on using digital tools and responsible practices to improve information services. For library professionals, research officers, archivists and knowledge managers, the course addresses digitizing workflows, supporting policy research and managing ESG resources. It covers AI-assisted cataloging and search, ethical data governance, digital preservation, and ways to reduce resource use while improving access to information.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who are integral to central bank library operations and knowledge management. It is designed to meet the needs of those who are ready to embrace digital transformation and sustainability at the core of their work.
modules: The Future of Central Bank Libraries
Ethical AI and Data Governance in Libraries
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of library operations and a basic familiarity with AI concepts. Experience in information management or related fields is recommended.
